why: The price is not material: the clearing removes 5,304 of 6,419 re-checks (83%) and forgoes 7 of 73 findings (10%), a yield of 0.13% on the cleared route against 5.9% on the kept one, about 45 times apart. The GM approved E as filed, and FR-005 lets a narrowing land 'stated and priced' where it cannot be proven; R3 has priced it. The bundle does not say whether the 4 DRIFTED came from the edit or were older drift the triage met by chance, so the price is taken as measured, all 7 counted against the clearing, and it still stands.
what: T05 lands the clearing as specified (FR-005 a). The session writes R3's price into research.md beside SC-004's before and after counts: 7 findings (4 DRIFTED, 3 MISLABELED, on 6 claims) in 5,304 triage-route re-checks since 2026-10-04 no longer caught, against 66 in 1,115 on the kept route. The claims cleared mechanically are recorded as such (FR-005 a), and that record is where a later sweep would sample them; no new sweep task and no further look into the 7 findings this feature.

why: FR-005's own 'measured first, then fixed' clause settles this: R2 measured that the bamboo/shelter/grove pop-ups behind 374#81 share no paragraph, so (b) built as filed leaves SC-004's pop-up count on that replay unchanged and cannot meet the spec's own success criterion. what: FR-005 (b) is waived and T04 closes on R2 with nothing built.
